title: What If You Could Run on Water? A Lizard Does, You'd Need 65 mph

scenes.text: What if you could run on water like a basilisk lizard? You'd need 65 miles an hour.
The lizard drives its feet down so hard and so fast that it never sinks deeper than a few inches.
Scientists Glasheen and McMahon worked out the human version. You would need almost 30 meters per second.
Usain Bolt topped out near 10 meters per second. That is only about a third of the speed you need.
And the power? You would have to produce roughly 15 times more than a human can sustain.
So you sink. The lizard gets away with it, and every human who has tried just gets wet.

description:
